/home/redkidd/SoloTime/HedgeyFund/valari/valari-contracts/lib/v4-periphery/src/libraries/CalldataDecoder.sol
   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
   2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.0;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | import {Currency} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/Currency.sol";
   5 |     | import {IV4Router} from "../interfaces/IV4Router.sol";
   6 |     | import {PoolKey} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/PoolKey.sol";
   7 |     | 
   8 |     | /// @title Library for abi decoding in calldata
   9 |     | library CalldataDecoder {
  10 |     |     using CalldataDecoder for bytes;
  11 |     | 
  12 |     |     error SliceOutOfBounds();
  13 |     | 
  14 |     |     /// @notice mask used for offsets and lengths to ensure no overflow
  15 |     |     /// @dev no sane abi encoding will pass in an offset or length greater than type(uint32).max
  16 |     |     ///      (note that this does deviate from standard solidity behavior and offsets/lengths will
  17 |     |     ///      be interpreted as mod type(uint32).max which will only impact malicious/buggy callers)
  18 |     |     uint256 constant OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK = 0xffffffff;
  19 |     |     uint256 constant OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK_AND_WORD_ALIGN = 0xffffffe0;
  20 |     | 
  21 |     |     /// @notice equivalent to SliceOutOfBounds.selector, stored in least-significant bits
  22 |     |     uint256 constant SLICE_ERROR_SELECTOR = 0x3b99b53d;
  23 |     | 
  24 |     |     /// @dev equivalent to: abi.decode(params, (bytes, bytes[])) in calldata (requires strict abi encoding)
  25 |     |     function decodeActionsRouterParams(bytes calldata _bytes)
  26 |     |         internal
  27 |     |         pure
  28 |     |         returns (bytes calldata actions, bytes[] calldata params)
  29 |     |     {
  30 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  31 |     |             // Strict encoding requires that the data begin with:
  32 |     |             // 0x00: 0x40 (offset to `actions.length`)
  33 |     |             // 0x20: 0x60 + actions.length (offset to `params.length`)
  34 |     |             // 0x40: `actions.length`
  35 |     |             // 0x60: beginning of actions
  36 |     | 
  37 |     |             // Verify actions offset matches strict encoding
  38 |     |             let invalidData := xor(calldataload(_bytes.offset), 0x40)
  39 |     |             actions.offset := add(_bytes.offset, 0x60)
  40 |     |             actions.length := and(calldataload(add(_bytes.offset, 0x40)), OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK)
  41 |     | 
  42 |     |             // Round actions length up to be word-aligned, and add 0x60 (for the first 3 words of encoding)
  43 |     |             let paramsLengthOffset := add(and(add(actions.length, 0x1f), OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK_AND_WORD_ALIGN), 0x60)
  44 |     |             // Verify params offset matches strict encoding
  45 |     |             invalidData := or(invalidData, xor(calldataload(add(_bytes.offset, 0x20)), paramsLengthOffset))
  46 |     |             let paramsLengthPointer := add(_bytes.offset, paramsLengthOffset)
  47 |     |             params.length := and(calldataload(paramsLengthPointer), OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK)
  48 |     |             params.offset := add(paramsLengthPointer, 0x20)
  49 |     | 
  50 |     |             // Expected offset for `params[0]` is params.length * 32
  51 |     |             // As the first `params.length` slots are pointers to each of the array element lengths
  52 |     |             let tailOffset := shl(5, params.length)
  53 |     |             let expectedOffset := tailOffset
  54 |     | 
  55 |     |             for { let offset := 0 } lt(offset, tailOffset) { offset := add(offset, 32) } {
  56 |     |                 let itemLengthOffset := calldataload(add(params.offset, offset))
  57 |     |                 // Verify that the offset matches the expected offset from strict encoding
  58 |     |                 invalidData := or(invalidData, xor(itemLengthOffset, expectedOffset))
  59 |     |                 let itemLengthPointer := add(params.offset, itemLengthOffset)
  60 |     |                 let length :=
  61 |     |                     add(and(add(calldataload(itemLengthPointer), 0x1f), OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK_AND_WORD_ALIGN), 0x20)
  62 |     |                 expectedOffset := add(expectedOffset, length)
  63 |     |             }
  64 |     | 
  65 |     |             // if the data encoding was invalid, or the provided bytes string isnt as long as the encoding says, revert
  66 |     |             if or(invalidData, lt(add(_bytes.length, _bytes.offset), add(params.offset, expectedOffset))) {
  67 |     |                 mstore(0, SLICE_ERROR_SELECTOR)
  68 |     |                 revert(0x1c, 4)
  69 |     |             }
  70 |     |         }
  71 |     |     }
  72 |     | 
  73 |     |     /// @dev equivalent to: abi.decode(params, (uint256, uint256, uint128, uint128, bytes)) in calldata
  74 | *   |     function decodeModifyLiquidityParams(bytes calldata params)
  75 |     |         internal
  76 |     |         pure
  77 |     |         returns (uint256 tokenId, uint256 liquidity, uint128 amount0, uint128 amount1, bytes calldata hookData)
  78 |     |     {
  79 |     |         // no length check performed, as there is a length check in `toBytes`
  80 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  81 |     |             tokenId := calldataload(params.offset)
  82 |     |             liquidity := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x20))
  83 |     |             amount0 := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x40))
  84 |     |             amount1 := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x60))
  85 |     |         }
  86 |     | 
  87 | *   |         hookData = params.toBytes(4);
  88 |     |     }
  89 |     | 
  90 |     |     /// @dev equivalent to: abi.decode(params, (uint256, uint128, uint128, bytes)) in calldata
  91 |     |     function decodeIncreaseLiquidityFromDeltasParams(bytes calldata params)
  92 |     |         internal
  93 |     |         pure
  94 |     |         returns (uint256 tokenId, uint128 amount0Max, uint128 amount1Max, bytes calldata hookData)
  95 |     |     {
  96 |     |         // no length check performed, as there is a length check in `toBytes`
  97 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  98 |     |             tokenId := calldataload(params.offset)
  99 |     |             amount0Max := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x20))
 100 |     |             amount1Max := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x40))
 101 |     |         }
 102 |     | 
 103 |     |         hookData = params.toBytes(3);
 104 |     |     }
 105 |     | 
 106 |     |     /// @dev equivalent to: abi.decode(params, (PoolKey, int24, int24, uint256, uint128, uint128, address, bytes)) in calldata
 107 | *   |     function decodeMintParams(bytes calldata params)
 108 |     |         internal
 109 |     |         pure
 110 |     |         returns (
 111 |     |             PoolKey calldata poolKey,
 112 |     |             int24 tickLower,
 113 |     |             int24 tickUpper,
 114 |     |             uint256 liquidity,
 115 |     |             uint128 amount0Max,
 116 |     |             uint128 amount1Max,
 117 |     |             address owner,
 118 |     |             bytes calldata hookData
 119 |     |         )
 120 |     |     {
 121 |     |         // no length check performed, as there is a length check in `toBytes`
 122 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 123 |     |             poolKey := params.offset
 124 |     |             tickLower := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0xa0))
 125 |     |             tickUpper := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0xc0))
 126 |     |             liquidity := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0xe0))
 127 |     |             amount0Max := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x100))
 128 |     |             amount1Max := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x120))
 129 |     |             owner := calldataload(add(params.offset, 0x140))
 130 |     |         }
 131 | *   |         hookData = params.toBytes(11);
 132 |     |     }
 133 |     | 
 134 |     |     /// @dev equivalent to: abi.decode(params, (PoolKey, int24, int24, uint128, uint128, address, bytes)) in calldata
 135 |     |     function decodeMintFromDeltasParams(bytes calldata params)
 136 |     |         internal
 137 |     |         pure
 138 |     |         returns (
 139 |     |             PoolKey calldata poolKey,
 140 |     |             int24 tickLower,
 141 |     |             int24 tickUpper,
 142 |     |             uint128 amount0Max,
 143 |     |             uint128 amount1Max,
 144 |     |             address owner,
 145 |     |             bytes calldata hookData

 362 |     |     /// @notice Decode the `_arg`-th element in `_bytes` as `bytes`
 363 |     |     /// @param _bytes The input bytes string to extract a bytes string from
 364 |     |     /// @param _arg The index of the argument to extract
 365 |     |     function toBytes(bytes calldata _bytes, uint256 _arg) internal pure returns (bytes calldata res) {
 366 |     |         uint256 length;
 367 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 368 |     |             // The offset of the `_arg`-th element is `32 * arg`, which stores the offset of the length pointer.
 369 |     |             // shl(5, x) is equivalent to mul(32, x)
 370 |     |             let lengthPtr :=
 371 |     |                 add(_bytes.offset, and(calldataload(add(_bytes.offset, shl(5, _arg))), OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK))
 372 |     |             // the number of bytes in the bytes string
 373 |     |             length := and(calldataload(lengthPtr), OFFSET_OR_LENGTH_MASK)
 374 |     |             // the offset where the bytes string begins
 375 |     |             let offset := add(lengthPtr, 0x20)
 376 |     |             // assign the return parameters
 377 |     |             res.length := length
 378 |     |             res.offset := offset
 379 |     | 
 380 |     |             // if the provided bytes string isnt as long as the encoding says, revert
 381 |     |             if lt(add(_bytes.length, _bytes.offset), add(length, offset)) {
 382 |     |                 mstore(0, SLICE_ERROR_SELECTOR)
 383 |     |                 revert(0x1c, 4)
 384 |     |             }
 385 |     |         }
 386 |     |     }

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

  4 |     | library ERC721PermitHash {
  5 |     |     /// @dev Value is equal to keccak256("Permit(address spender,uint256 tokenId,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)");
  6 |     |     bytes32 constant PERMIT_TYPEHASH = 0x49ecf333e5b8c95c40fdafc95c1ad136e8914a8fb55e9dc8bb01eaa83a2df9ad;
  7 |     | 
  8 |     |     /// @dev Value is equal to keccak256("PermitForAll(address operator,bool approved,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)");
  9 |     |     bytes32 constant PERMIT_FOR_ALL_TYPEHASH = 0x6673cb397ee2a50b6b8401653d3638b4ac8b3db9c28aa6870ffceb7574ec2f76;
 10 |     | 
 11 |     |     /// @notice Hashes the data that will be signed for IERC721Permit_v4.permit()
 12 |     |     /// @param spender The address which may spend the tokenId
 13 |     |     /// @param tokenId The tokenId of the owner, which may be spent by spender
 14 |     |     /// @param nonce A unique non-ordered value for each signature to prevent replay attacks
 15 |     |     /// @param deadline The time at which the signature expires
 16 |     |     /// @return digest The hash of the data to be signed; the equivalent to keccak256(abi.encode(PERMIT_TYPEHASH, spender, tokenId, nonce, deadline));
 17 |     |     function hashPermit(address spender, uint256 tokenId, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline)
 18 |     |         internal
 19 |     |         pure
 20 |     |         returns (bytes32 digest)
 21 |     |     {
 22 |     |         // equivalent to: keccak256(abi.encode(PERMIT_TYPEHASH, spender, tokenId, nonce, deadline));
 23 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 24 |     |             let fmp := mload(0x40)
 25 |     |             mstore(fmp, PERMIT_TYPEHASH)
 26 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x20), and(spender, 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff))
 27 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x40), tokenId)
 28 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x60), nonce)
 29 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x80), deadline)
 30 |     |             digest := keccak256(fmp, 0xa0)
 31 |     | 
 32 |     |             // now clean the memory we used
 33 |     |             mstore(fmp, 0) // fmp held PERMIT_TYPEHASH
 34 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x20), 0) // fmp+0x20 held spender
 35 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x40), 0) // fmp+0x40 held tokenId
 36 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x60), 0) // fmp+0x60 held nonce
 37 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x80), 0) // fmp+0x80 held deadline
 38 |     |         }
 39 |     |     }
 40 |     | 
 41 |     |     /// @notice Hashes the data that will be signed for IERC721Permit_v4.permit()
 42 |     |     /// @param operator The address which may spend any of the owner's tokenIds
 43 |     |     /// @param approved true if the operator is to have full permission over the owner's tokenIds; false otherwise
 44 |     |     /// @param nonce A unique non-ordered value for each signature to prevent replay attacks
 45 |     |     /// @param deadline The time at which the signature expires
 46 |     |     /// @return digest The hash of the data to be signed; the equivalent to keccak256(abi.encode(PERMIT_FOR_ALL_TYPEHASH, operator, approved, nonce, deadline));
 47 |     |     function hashPermitForAll(address operator, bool approved, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline)
 48 |     |         internal
 49 |     |         pure
 50 |     |         returns (bytes32 digest)
 51 |     |     {
 52 |     |         // equivalent to: keccak256(abi.encode(PERMIT_FOR_ALL_TYPEHASH, operator, approved, nonce, deadline));
 53 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 54 |     |             let fmp := mload(0x40)
 55 |     |             mstore(fmp, PERMIT_FOR_ALL_TYPEHASH)
 56 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x20), and(operator, 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff))
 57 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x40), and(approved, 0x1))
 58 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x60), nonce)
 59 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x80), deadline)
 60 |     |             digest := keccak256(fmp, 0xa0)
 61 |     | 
 62 |     |             // now clean the memory we used
 63 |     |             mstore(fmp, 0) // fmp held PERMIT_FOR_ALL_TYPEHASH
 64 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x20), 0) // fmp+0x20 held operator
 65 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x40), 0) // fmp+0x40 held approved
 66 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x60), 0) // fmp+0x60 held nonce
 67 |     |             mstore(add(fmp, 0x80), 0) // fmp+0x80 held deadline
 68 |     |         }
 69 |     |     }

  7 |     | 
  8 |     | /// @notice Provides functions for computing liquidity amounts from token amounts and prices
  9 |     | library LiquidityAmounts {
 10 |     |     using SafeCast for uint256;
 11 |     | 
 12 |     |     /// @notice Computes the amount of liquidity received for a given amount of token0 and price range
 13 |     |     /// @dev Calculates amount0 * (sqrt(upper) * sqrt(lower)) / (sqrt(upper) - sqrt(lower))
 14 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
 15 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
 16 |     |     /// @param amount0 The amount0 being sent in
 17 |     |     /// @return liquidity The amount of returned liquidity
 18 | *   |     function getLiquidityForAmount0(uint160 sqrtPriceAX96, uint160 sqrtPriceBX96, uint256 amount0)
 19 |     |         internal
 20 |     |         pure
 21 |     |         returns (uint128 liquidity)
 22 |     |     {
 23 |     |         unchecked {
 24 | *   |             if (sqrtPriceAX96 > sqrtPriceBX96) (sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96) = (sqrtPriceBX96, sqrtPriceAX96);
 25 | *   |             uint256 intermediate = FullMath.mulDiv(sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96, FixedPoint96.Q96);
 26 | *   |             return FullMath.mulDiv(amount0, intermediate, sqrtPriceBX96 - sqrtPriceAX96).toUint128();
 27 |     |         }
 28 |     |     }
 29 |     | 
 30 |     |     /// @notice Computes the amount of liquidity received for a given amount of token1 and price range
 31 |     |     /// @dev Calculates amount1 / (sqrt(upper) - sqrt(lower)).
 32 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
 33 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
 34 |     |     /// @param amount1 The amount1 being sent in

 36 | *   |     function getLiquidityForAmount1(uint160 sqrtPriceAX96, uint160 sqrtPriceBX96, uint256 amount1)
 37 |     |         internal
 38 |     |         pure
 39 |     |         returns (uint128 liquidity)
 40 |     |     {
 41 |     |         unchecked {
 42 | *   |             if (sqrtPriceAX96 > sqrtPriceBX96) (sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96) = (sqrtPriceBX96, sqrtPriceAX96);
 43 | *   |             return FullMath.mulDiv(amount1, FixedPoint96.Q96, sqrtPriceBX96 - sqrtPriceAX96).toUint128();
 44 |     |         }
 45 |     |     }
 46 |     | 
 47 |     |     /// @notice Computes the maximum amount of liquidity received for a given amount of token0, token1, the current
 48 |     |     /// pool prices and the prices at the tick boundaries
 49 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceX96 A sqrt price representing the current pool prices
 50 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceAX96 A sqrt price representing the first tick boundary
 51 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceBX96 A sqrt price representing the second tick boundary
 52 |     |     /// @param amount0 The amount of token0 being sent in

 58 |     |         uint160 sqrtPriceBX96,
 59 |     |         uint256 amount0,
 60 |     |         uint256 amount1

 64 |     |         }

 66 | *   |         if (sqrtPriceX96 <= sqrtPriceAX96) {
 67 | *   |             liquidity = getLiquidityForAmount0(sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96, amount0);
 68 | *   |         } else if (sqrtPriceX96 < sqrtPriceBX96) {

 18 |     | /// @title PathKey Library
 19 |     | /// @notice Functions for working with PathKeys
 20 |     | library PathKeyLibrary {
 21 |     |     /// @notice Get the pool and swap direction for a given PathKey
 22 |     |     /// @param params the given PathKey
 23 |     |     /// @param currencyIn the input currency
 24 |     |     /// @return poolKey the pool key of the swap
 25 |     |     /// @return zeroForOne the direction of the swap, true if currency0 is being swapped for currency1
 26 |     |     function getPoolAndSwapDirection(PathKey calldata params, Currency currencyIn)
 27 |     |         internal
 28 |     |         pure
 29 |     |         returns (PoolKey memory poolKey, bool zeroForOne)
 30 |     |     {
 31 |     |         Currency currencyOut = params.intermediateCurrency;
 32 |     |         (Currency currency0, Currency currency1) =
 33 |     |             currencyIn < currencyOut ? (currencyIn, currencyOut) : (currencyOut, currencyIn);
 34 |     | 
 35 |     |         zeroForOne = currencyIn == currency0;
 36 |     |         poolKey = PoolKey(currency0, currency1, params.fee, params.tickSpacing, params.hooks);
 37 |     |     }

   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
   2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | import {PoolKey} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/PoolKey.sol";
   5 |     | import {PoolId} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/PoolId.sol";
   6 |     | 
   7 |     | /**
   8 |     |  * @dev PositionInfo is a packed version of solidity structure.
   9 |     |  * Using the packaged version saves gas and memory by not storing the structure fields in memory slots.
  10 |     |  *
  11 |     |  * Layout:
  12 |     |  * 200 bits poolId | 24 bits tickUpper | 24 bits tickLower | 8 bits hasSubscriber
  13 |     |  *
  14 |     |  * Fields in the direction from the least significant bit:
  15 |     |  *
  16 |     |  * A flag to know if the tokenId is subscribed to an address
  17 |     |  * uint8 hasSubscriber;
  18 |     |  *
  19 |     |  * The tickUpper of the position
  20 |     |  * int24 tickUpper;
  21 |     |  *
  22 |     |  * The tickLower of the position
  23 |     |  * int24 tickLower;
  24 |     |  *
  25 |     |  * The truncated poolId. Truncates a bytes32 value so the most signifcant (highest) 200 bits are used.
  26 |     |  * bytes25 poolId;
  27 |     |  *
  28 |     |  * Note: If more bits are needed, hasSubscriber can be a single bit.
  29 |     |  *
  30 |     |  */
  31 |     | type PositionInfo is uint256;
  32 |     | 
  33 |     | using PositionInfoLibrary for PositionInfo global;
  34 |     | 
  35 |     | library PositionInfoLibrary {
  36 | *   |     PositionInfo internal constant EMPTY_POSITION_INFO = PositionInfo.wrap(0);
  37 |     | 
  38 |     |     uint256 internal constant MASK_UPPER_200_BITS = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00000000000000;
  39 |     |     uint256 internal constant MASK_8_BITS = 0xFF;
  40 |     |     uint24 internal constant MASK_24_BITS = 0xFFFFFF;
  41 |     |     uint256 internal constant SET_UNSUBSCRIBE = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00;
  42 |     |     uint256 internal constant SET_SUBSCRIBE = 0x01;
  43 |     |     uint8 internal constant TICK_LOWER_OFFSET = 8;
  44 |     |     uint8 internal constant TICK_UPPER_OFFSET = 32;
  45 |     | 
  46 |     |     /// @dev This poolId is NOT compatible with the poolId used in UniswapV4 core. It is truncated to 25 bytes, and just used to lookup PoolKey in the poolKeys mapping.
  47 |     |     function poolId(PositionInfo info) internal pure returns (bytes25 _poolId) {
  48 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  49 |     |             _poolId := and(MASK_UPPER_200_BITS, info)
  50 |     |         }
  51 |     |     }
  52 |     | 
  53 |     |     function tickLower(PositionInfo info) internal pure returns (int24 _tickLower) {
  54 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  55 |     |             _tickLower := signextend(2, shr(TICK_LOWER_OFFSET, info))
  56 |     |         }
  57 |     |     }
  58 |     | 
  59 |     |     function tickUpper(PositionInfo info) internal pure returns (int24 _tickUpper) {
  60 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  61 |     |             _tickUpper := signextend(2, shr(TICK_UPPER_OFFSET, info))
  62 |     |         }
  63 |     |     }
  64 |     | 
  65 | *   |     function hasSubscriber(PositionInfo info) internal pure returns (bool _hasSubscriber) {
  66 | *   |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  67 |     |             _hasSubscriber := and(MASK_8_BITS, info)
  68 |     |         }
  69 |     |     }
  70 |     | 
  71 |     |     /// @dev this does not actually set any storage
  72 |     |     function setSubscribe(PositionInfo info) internal pure returns (PositionInfo _info) {
  73 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  74 |     |             _info := or(info, SET_SUBSCRIBE)
  75 |     |         }
  76 |     |     }
  77 |     | 
  78 |     |     /// @dev this does not actually set any storage
  79 |     |     function setUnsubscribe(PositionInfo info) internal pure returns (PositionInfo _info) {
  80 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  81 |     |             _info := and(info, SET_UNSUBSCRIBE)
  82 |     |         }
  83 |     |     }
  84 |     | 
  85 |     |     /// @notice Creates the default PositionInfo struct
  86 |     |     /// @dev Called when minting a new position
  87 |     |     /// @param _poolKey the pool key of the position
  88 |     |     /// @param _tickLower the lower tick of the position
  89 |     |     /// @param _tickUpper the upper tick of the position
  90 |     |     /// @return info packed position info, with the truncated poolId and the hasSubscriber flag set to false
  91 | *   |     function initialize(PoolKey memory _poolKey, int24 _tickLower, int24 _tickUpper)
  92 |     |         internal
  93 |     |         pure
  94 |     |         returns (PositionInfo info)
  95 |     |     {
  96 |     |         bytes25 _poolId = bytes25(PoolId.unwrap(_poolKey.toId()));
  97 | *   |         assembly {
  98 |     |             info := or(
  99 |     |                 or(and(MASK_UPPER_200_BITS, _poolId), shl(TICK_UPPER_OFFSET, and(MASK_24_BITS, _tickUpper))),
 100 |     |                 shl(TICK_LOWER_OFFSET, and(MASK_24_BITS, _tickLower))
 101 |     |             )
 102 |     |         }
 103 |     |     }
 104 |     | }

/home/redkidd/SoloTime/HedgeyFund/valari/valari-contracts/lib/v4-periphery/src/libraries/SlippageCheck.sol
  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.0;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {BalanceDelta} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/BalanceDelta.sol";
  5 |     | import {SafeCast} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/libraries/SafeCast.sol";
  6 |     | 
  7 |     | /// @title Slippage Check Library
  8 |     | /// @notice a library for checking if a delta exceeds a maximum ceiling or fails to meet a minimum floor
  9 |     | library SlippageCheck {
 10 |     |     using SafeCast for int128;
 11 |     | 
 12 |     |     error MaximumAmountExceeded(uint128 maximumAmount, uint128 amountRequested);
 13 |     |     error MinimumAmountInsufficient(uint128 minimumAmount, uint128 amountReceived);
 14 |     | 
 15 |     |     /// @notice Revert if one or both deltas does not meet a minimum output
 16 |     |     /// @param delta The principal amount of tokens to be removed, does not include any fees accrued
 17 |     |     /// @param amount0Min The minimum amount of token0 to receive
 18 |     |     /// @param amount1Min The minimum amount of token1 to receive
 19 |     |     /// @dev This should be called when removing liquidity (burn or decrease)
 20 | *   |     function validateMinOut(BalanceDelta delta, uint128 amount0Min, uint128 amount1Min) internal pure {
 21 |     |         // Called on burn or decrease, where we expect the returned delta to be positive.
 22 |     |         // However, on pools where hooks can return deltas on modify liquidity, it is possible for a returned delta to be negative.
 23 |     |         // Because we use SafeCast, this will revert in those cases when the delta is negative.
 24 |     |         // This means this contract will NOT support pools where the hook returns a negative delta on burn/decrease.
 25 | *   |         if (delta.amount0().toUint128() < amount0Min) {
 26 |     |             revert MinimumAmountInsufficient(amount0Min, delta.amount0().toUint128());
 27 |     |         }
 28 | *   |         if (delta.amount1().toUint128() < amount1Min) {
 29 |     |             revert MinimumAmountInsufficient(amount1Min, delta.amount1().toUint128());
 30 |     |         }
 31 |     |     }
 32 |     | 
 33 |     |     /// @notice Revert if one or both deltas exceeds a maximum input
 34 |     |     /// @param delta The principal amount of tokens to be added, does not include any fees accrued (which is possible on increase)
 35 |     |     /// @param amount0Max The maximum amount of token0 to spend
 36 |     |     /// @param amount1Max The maximum amount of token1 to spend
 37 |     |     /// @dev This should be called when adding liquidity (mint or increase)
 38 | *   |     function validateMaxIn(BalanceDelta delta, uint128 amount0Max, uint128 amount1Max) internal pure {
 39 |     |         // Called on mint or increase, where we expect the returned delta to be negative.
 40 |     |         // However, on pools where hooks can return deltas on modify liquidity, it is possible for a returned delta to be positive (even after discounting fees accrued).
 41 |     |         // Thus, we only cast the delta if it is guaranteed to be negative.
 42 |     |         // And we do NOT revert in the positive delta case. Since a positive delta means the hook is crediting tokens to the user for minting/increasing liquidity, we do not check slippage.
 43 |     |         // This means this contract will NOT support _positive_ slippage checks (minAmountOut checks) on pools where the hook returns a positive delta on mint/increase.
 44 |     |         int256 amount0 = delta.amount0();
 45 |     |         int256 amount1 = delta.amount1();
 46 | *   |         if (amount0 < 0 && amount0Max < uint128(uint256(-amount0))) {
 47 |     |             revert MaximumAmountExceeded(amount0Max, uint128(uint256(-amount0)));
 48 |     |         }
 49 | *   |         if (amount1 < 0 && amount1Max < uint128(uint256(-amount1))) {
 50 |     |             revert MaximumAmountExceeded(amount1Max, uint128(uint256(-amount1)));
 51 |     |         }
 52 |     |     }
 53 |     | }

  7 |     | import {ValariRouterV3} from "../src/ValariRouterV3.sol";
  8 |     | 
  9 |     | /// @notice Appends every catalog pool the router does not list yet. Safe to re-run: pools
 10 |     | /// already listed are skipped, so it brings a router up to date with a grown catalog.
 11 |     | /// A stock may appear more than once, under different fee tiers.
 12 |     | /// @dev VALARI_ROUTER_V3 is the deployed router; the signer must be its owner.
 13 |     | /// VALARI_POOLS_CONFIG optionally names another catalog under config/ (same format as
 14 |     | /// config/robinhood.json, any number of pools).
 15 |     | contract AddValariRouterV3Pools is Script {
 16 |     |     using PoolIdLibrary for PoolKey;
 17 |     | 
 18 |     |     function run() external returns (uint256 added) {
 19 |     |         ValariRouterV3 router = ValariRouterV3(vm.envAddress("VALARI_ROUTER_V3"));
 20 |     |         string memory path = vm.envOr("VALARI_POOLS_CONFIG", string("config/robinhood.json"));
 21 |     |         string memory config = vm.readFile(path);
 22 |     |         require(
 23 |     |             block.chainid == 4663 && vm.parseJsonUint(config, ".chainId") == 4663, "Wrong chain"
 24 |     |         );
 25 |     |         require(address(router).code.length != 0, "No router at VALARI_ROUTER_V3");
 26 |     |         // Only V3 has this getter: the earlier routers would otherwise pass every check
 27 |     |         // below and report "0 pools added" against the wrong contract.
 28 |     |         try router.MAX_PAYOUT_DUST() returns (uint256) {}
 29 |     |         catch {
 30 |     |             revert("VALARI_ROUTER_V3 is not a ValariRouterV3");
 31 |     |         }
 32 |     |         require(
 33 |     |             address(router.positionManager()) == vm.parseJsonAddress(config, ".positionManager"),
 34 |     |             "Wrong PositionManager"
 35 |     |         );
 36 |     |         require(
 37 |     |             address(router.stateView()) == vm.parseJsonAddress(config, ".stateView"),
 38 |     |             "Wrong StateView"
 39 |     |         );
 40 |     |         require(router.usdg() == vm.parseJsonAddress(config, ".usdg"), "Wrong USDG");
 41 |     |         PoolKey[] memory keys = abi.decode(vm.parseJsonBytes(config, ".poolKeysAbi"), (PoolKey[]));
 42 |     |         bytes32[] memory ids = vm.parseJsonBytes32Array(config, ".poolIds");
 43 |     |         require(keys.length == ids.length, "Pool list mismatch");
 44 |     | 
 45 |     |         // Decide everything before sending anything, so a bad catalog sends no transaction.
 46 |     |         bool[] memory missing = new bool[](keys.length);
 47 |     |         for (uint256 i; i < keys.length; ++i) {
 48 |     |             require(PoolId.unwrap(keys[i].toId()) == ids[i], "Pool ID mismatch");
 49 |     |             // getPoolKey reverts for a pool the router does not list.
 50 |     |             try router.getPoolKey(ids[i]) returns (PoolKey memory) {}
 51 |     |             catch {
 52 |     |                 missing[i] = true;
 53 |     |             }
 54 |     |         }
 55 |     | 
 56 |     |         uint256 countBefore = router.poolCount();
 57 |     |         vm.startBroadcast();
 58 |     |         for (uint256 i; i < keys.length; ++i) {
 59 |     |             if (!missing[i]) continue;
 60 |     |             require(router.addPool(keys[i]) == ids[i], "Unexpected pool ID");
 61 |     |             ++added;
 62 |     |         }
 63 |     |         vm.stopBroadcast();
 64 |     | 
 65 |     |         require(router.poolCount() == countBefore + added, "Catalog size mismatch");
 66 |     |         console2.log("ValariRouterV3:", address(router));
 67 |     |         console2.log("Pools added:", added);
 68 |     |         console2.log("Pool count:", router.poolCount());
 69 |     |     }
 70 |     | }

  30 |     | /// @title ValariRouter

  58 |     | 
  59 |     |     struct DepositQuote {

 190 |     |     /// @dev The deployment catalog is fixed for the lifetime of this router.
 191 |     |     /// Deploy with the checked-in 100-pool Robinhood configuration.
 192 |     |     constructor(
 193 |     |         IPositionManager positionManager_,
 194 |     |         IStateView stateView_,
 195 |     |         address usdg_,
 196 |     |         PoolKey[] memory pools_
 197 |     |     ) Ownable(msg.sender) {
 198 |     |         if (
 199 |     |             address(positionManager_).code.length == 0 || address(stateView_).code.length == 0
 200 |     |                 || usdg_.code.length == 0 || pools_.length == 0 || pools_.length > MAX_POOLS
 201 |     |         ) revert InvalidConfiguration();
 202 |     |         IPoolManager manager = positionManager_.poolManager();
 203 |     |         IAllowanceTransfer allowanceTransfer = IPermit2Source(address(positionManager_)).permit2();
 204 |     |         if (
 205 |     |             address(manager).code.length == 0 || stateView_.poolManager() != manager
 206 |     |                 || address(allowanceTransfer).code.length == 0
 207 |     |         ) revert InvalidConfiguration();
 208 |     |         positionManager = positionManager_;
 209 |     |         stateView = stateView_;
 210 |     |         poolManager = manager;
 211 |     |         permit2 = allowanceTransfer;
 212 |     |         usdg = usdg_;
 213 |     |         feeRecipient = msg.sender;
 214 |     |         emit FeeRecipientUpdated(address(0), msg.sender);
 215 |     | 
 216 |     |         for (uint256 i; i < pools_.length; ++i) {
 217 |     |             PoolKey memory key = pools_[i];
 218 |     |             bytes32 id = PoolId.unwrap(key.toId());
 219 |     |             address token0 = Currency.unwrap(key.currency0);
 220 |     |             address token1 = Currency.unwrap(key.currency1);
 221 |     |             if (
 222 |     |                 token0 >= token1 || token0.code.length == 0 || token1.code.length == 0
 223 |     |                     || (token0 != usdg_ && token1 != usdg_) || address(key.hooks) != address(0)
 224 |     |                     || key.tickSpacing < TickMath.MIN_TICK_SPACING
 225 |     |                     || key.tickSpacing > TickMath.MAX_TICK_SPACING
 226 |     |             ) revert InvalidPool(id);
 227 |     |             address stock = token0 == usdg_ ? token1 : token0;
 228 |     |             if (stockPoolId[stock] != bytes32(0)) revert DuplicateStock(stock);
 229 |     |             (uint160 sqrtPriceX96,,,) = stateView_.getSlot0(PoolId.wrap(id));
 230 |     |             if (sqrtPriceX96 == 0) revert InvalidPool(id);
 231 |     |             _pools[id] = key;
 232 |     |             _poolIds.push(id);
 233 |     |             stockPoolId[stock] = id;
 234 |     |         }
 235 |     |     }
 236 |     | 
 237 |     |     /// @notice Mint an LP NFT into Valari custody for the caller and refund unused budgets.
 238 |     |     /// @param poolId A pool in this router's fixed catalog.
 239 |     |     /// @param amount0Max Maximum currency0 units the caller will spend.
 240 |     |     /// @param amount1Max Maximum currency1 units the caller will spend.
 241 |     |     /// @param tickLower Inclusive lower v4 tick, aligned to tickSpacing.
 242 |     |     /// @param tickUpper Exclusive upper v4 tick, aligned to tickSpacing.
 243 |     |     /// @param minLiquidity Caller-selected minimum from a prior quote; must be nonzero.
 244 |     |     /// @param deadline Caller-selected last permissible block timestamp.
 245 |     |     function openPosition(
 246 |     |         bytes32 poolId,
 247 |     |         uint128 amount0Max,
 248 |     |         uint128 amount1Max,
 249 |     |         int24 tickLower,
 250 |     |         int24 tickUpper,
 251 |     |         uint128 minLiquidity,
 252 |     |         uint256 deadline
 253 |     |     )
 254 |     |         external
 255 |     |         nonReentrant
 256 |     |         returns (uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)
 257 |     |     {
 258 |     |         if (block.timestamp > deadline) {
 259 |     |             revert DeadlineExpired();
 260 |     |         }
 261 |     |         if (minLiquidity == 0) revert InvalidLiquidity();
 262 |     |         PoolKey memory key = getPoolKey(poolId);
 263 |     |         DepositQuote memory quote =
 264 |     |             previewDeposit(poolId, amount0Max, amount1Max, tickLower, tickUpper);
 265 |     |         liquidity = quote.liquidity;
 266 |     |         if (liquidity < minLiquidity) revert LiquidityBelowMinimum(liquidity, minLiquidity);
 267 |     | 
 268 |     |         IERC20 token0 = IERC20(Currency.unwrap(key.currency0));
 269 |     |         IERC20 token1 = IERC20(Currency.unwrap(key.currency1));
 270 |     |         uint256 before0 = _pull(token0, amount0Max);
 271 |     |         uint256 before1 = _pull(token1, amount1Max);
 272 |     |         _approve(token0, amount0Max);
 273 |     |         _approve(token1, amount1Max);
 274 |     | 
 275 |     |         bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](2);
 276 |     |         params[0] = abi.encode(
 277 |     |             key,
 278 |     |             tickLower,
 279 |     |             tickUpper,
 280 |     |             uint256(liquidity),
 281 |     |             amount0Max,
 282 |     |             amount1Max,
 283 |     |             address(this),
 284 |     |             bytes("")
 285 |     |         );
 286 |     |         params[1] = abi.encode(key.currency0, key.currency1);
 287 |     |         // Sample after token callbacks/approvals, immediately before the mint.
 288 |     |         tokenId = positionManager.nextTokenId();
 289 |     |         positionManager.modifyLiquidities(
 290 |     |             abi.encode(
 291 |     |                 abi.encodePacked(uint8(Actions.MINT_POSITION), uint8(Actions.SETTLE_PAIR)), params
 292 |     |             ),
 293 |     |             deadline
 294 |     |         );
 295 |     |         if (
 296 |     |             IERC721(address(positionManager)).ownerOf(tokenId) != address(this)
 297 |     |                 || positionManager.getPositionLiquidity(tokenId) != liquidity
 298 |     |                 || positionManager.nextTokenId() != tokenId + 1
 299 |     |         ) revert UnexpectedPosition();
 300 |     | 
 301 |     |         _approve(token0, 0);
 302 |     |         _approve(token1, 0);
 303 |     |         amount0 = _refund(token0, before0, amount0Max);
 304 |     |         amount1 = _refund(token1, before1, amount1Max);
 305 |     | 
 306 |     |         DepositRecord storage record = _deposits[tokenId];
 307 |     |         record.poolId = poolId;
 308 |     |         record.depositor = msg.sender;
 309 |     |         record.openedAt = block.timestamp.toUint64();
 310 |     |         record.tickLower = tickLower;
 311 |     |         record.tickUpper = tickUpper;
 312 |     |         record.initialLiquidity = liquidity;
 313 |     |         record.amount0Deposited = amount0.toUint128();
 314 |     |         record.amount1Deposited = amount1.toUint128();
 315 |     |         _positionIds.push(tokenId);
 316 |     |         _depositorPositionIds[msg.sender].push(tokenId);
 317 |     |         emit PositionOpened(
 318 |     |             msg.sender, tokenId, poolId, tickLower, tickUpper, liquidity, amount0, amount1
 319 |     |         );
 320 |     |     }
 321 |     | 
 322 |     |     /// @notice Update the recipient of future commissions; existing credits keep their owner.
 323 |     |     function setFeeRecipient(address newRecipient) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
 324 |     |         if (newRecipient == address(0) || newRecipient == address(this)) {
 325 |     |             revert InvalidFeeRecipient();
 326 |     |         }
 327 |     |         address previous = feeRecipient;
 328 |     |         feeRecipient = newRecipient;
 329 |     |         emit FeeRecipientUpdated(previous, newRecipient);
 330 |     |     }
 331 |     | 
 332 |     |     /// @notice Withdraw the caller's accrued commission, independently of user LP operations.
 333 |     |     /// @dev A recipient may use a different destination if a token restricts its own address.
 334 |     |     /// Owner privileges do not grant access to another recipient's existing credits.
 335 |     |     function withdrawCommission(address token, address to, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
 336 |     |         if (token == address(0) || to == address(0) || to == address(this) || amount == 0) {
 337 |     |             revert InvalidCommissionWithdrawal();
 338 |     |         }
 339 |     |         uint256 credit = claimableCommission[msg.sender][token];
 340 |     |         if (amount > credit) revert InsufficientCommission();
 341 |     |         IERC20 currency = IERC20(token);
 342 |     |         uint256 beforeBalance = currency.balanceOf(address(this));
 343 |     |         uint256 total = totalClaimableCommission[token];
 344 |     |         if (beforeBalance < total) revert InsufficientProceeds();
 345 |     | 
 346 |     |         // Effects before interactions; a failed transfer restores both liabilities.
 347 |     |         claimableCommission[msg.sender][token] = credit - amount;
 348 |     |         totalClaimableCommission[token] = total - amount;
 349 |     |         currency.safeTransfer(to, amount);
 350 |     |         if (currency.balanceOf(address(this)) != beforeBalance - amount) {
 351 |     |             revert UnsupportedToken(token);
 352 |     |         }
 353 |     |         emit CommissionWithdrawn(msg.sender, token, to, amount);
 354 |     |     }
 355 |     | 
 356 |     |     /// @notice Pay the user's net LP fees and accrue Valari's 10% commission for later withdrawal.
 357 |     |     /// @dev Liquidity stays invested. Only the recorded beneficiary can call this function.
 358 |     |     function collectFees(uint256 tokenId, uint256 deadline)
 359 |     |         external
 360 |     |         nonReentrant
 361 |     |         returns (Payout memory payout)
 362 |     |     {
 363 |     |         DepositRecord storage record = _ownedPosition(tokenId);
 364 |     |         if (block.timestamp > deadline) revert DeadlineExpired();
 365 |     |         PoolKey memory key = _pools[record.poolId];
 366 |     |         IERC20 token0 = IERC20(Currency.unwrap(key.currency0));
 367 |     |         IERC20 token1 = IERC20(Currency.unwrap(key.currency1));
 368 |     |         uint256 before0 = token0.balanceOf(address(this));
 369 |     |         uint256 before1 = token1.balanceOf(address(this));
 370 |     |         uint128 liquidity = positionManager.getPositionLiquidity(tokenId);
 371 |     |         bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](2);
 372 |     |         params[0] = abi.encode(tokenId, uint256(0), uint128(0), uint128(0), bytes(""));
 373 |     |         params[1] = abi.encode(key.currency0, key.currency1, address(this));
 374 |     |         positionManager.modifyLiquidities(
 375 |     |             abi.encode(
 376 |     |                 abi.encodePacked(uint8(Actions.DECREASE_LIQUIDITY), uint8(Actions.TAKE_PAIR)),
 377 |     |                 params
 378 |     |             ),
 379 |     |             deadline
 380 |     |         );
 381 |     |         if (
 382 |     |             positionManager.getPositionLiquidity(tokenId) != liquidity
 383 |     |                 || _ownerOf(tokenId) != address(this)
 384 |     |         ) {
 385 |     |             revert UnexpectedPosition();
 386 |     |         }
 387 |     |         _distribute(record, payout, token0, token1, before0, before1);
 388 |     |         emit FeesCollected(
 389 |     |             record.depositor,
 390 |     |             tokenId,
 391 |     |             feeRecipient,
 392 |     |             payout.fees0,
 393 |     |             payout.fees1,
 394 |     |             payout.commission0,
 395 |     |             payout.commission1
 396 |     |         );
 397 |     |     }
 398 |     | 
 399 |     |     /// @notice Fully exit and burn the NFT, returning all principal plus fees less 10% of fees.
 400 |     |     /// @param amount0Min Minimum currency0 PRINCIPAL to withdraw, excluding fees.
 401 |     |     /// @param amount1Min Minimum currency1 PRINCIPAL to withdraw, excluding fees.
 402 |     |     function exitPosition(uint256 tokenId, uint128 amount0Min, uint128 amount1Min, uint256 deadline)
 403 |     |         external
 404 |     |         nonReentrant
 405 |     |         returns (Payout memory payout)
 406 |     |     {
 407 |     |         DepositRecord storage record = _ownedPosition(tokenId);
 408 |     |         if (block.timestamp > deadline) revert DeadlineExpired();
 409 |     |         PoolKey memory key = _pools[record.poolId];
 410 |     |         IERC20 token0 = IERC20(Currency.unwrap(key.currency0));
 411 |     |         IERC20 token1 = IERC20(Currency.unwrap(key.currency1));
 412 |     |         uint128 liquidity = positionManager.getPositionLiquidity(tokenId);
 413 |     |         (uint160 price,,,) = stateView.getSlot0(PoolId.wrap(record.poolId));
 414 |     |         (payout.principal0, payout.principal1) = _amounts(
 415 |     |             price,
 416 |     |             TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(record.tickLower),
 417 |     |             TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(record.tickUpper),
 418 |     |             liquidity,
 419 |     |             false
 420 |     |         );
 421 |     |         if (payout.principal0 < amount0Min || payout.principal1 < amount1Min) {
 422 |     |             revert InsufficientProceeds();
 423 |     |         }
 424 |     |         uint256 before0 = token0.balanceOf(address(this));
 425 |     |         uint256 before1 = token1.balanceOf(address(this));
 426 |     |         // No hooks/subscribers or token transfers run before this position's liquidity is
 427 |     |         // removed. The snapshot above therefore matches v4's exact rounded-down principal.
 428 |     |         record.closed = true;
 429 |     |         bytes[] memory params = new bytes[](2);
 430 |     |         params[0] = abi.encode(tokenId, amount0Min, amount1Min, bytes(""));
 431 |     |         params[1] = abi.encode(key.currency0, key.currency1, address(this));
 432 |     |         positionManager.modifyLiquidities(
 433 |     |             abi.encode(
 434 |     |                 abi.encodePacked(uint8(Actions.BURN_POSITION), uint8(Actions.TAKE_PAIR)), params
 435 |     |             ),
 436 |     |             deadline
 437 |     |         );
 438 |     |         if (_ownerOf(tokenId) != address(0)) revert UnexpectedPosition();
 439 |     |         _distribute(record, payout, token0, token1, before0, before1);
 440 |     |         emit PositionExited(
 441 |     |             record.depositor,
 442 |     |             tokenId,
 443 |     |             feeRecipient,
 444 |     |             payout.principal0,
 445 |     |             payout.principal1,
 446 |     |             payout.fees0,
 447 |     |             payout.fees1,
 448 |     |             payout.commission0,
 449 |     |             payout.commission1
 450 |     |         );
 451 |     |     }
 452 |     | 
 453 |     |     /// @notice Live quote; apply the user's slippage tolerance to liquidity for minLiquidity.
 454 |     |     /// @dev Required funding amounts round up, just as minting does in Uniswap.
 455 |     |     function previewDeposit(
 456 |     |         bytes32 poolId,
 457 |     |         uint128 amount0Max,
 458 |     |         uint128 amount1Max,
 459 |     |         int24 tickLower,
 460 |     |         int24 tickUpper
 461 |     |     ) public view returns (DepositQuote memory quote) {
 462 |     |         PoolKey memory key = getPoolKey(poolId);
 463 |     |         if (
 464 |     |             tickLower >= tickUpper || tickLower < TickMath.MIN_TICK || tickUpper > TickMath.MAX_TICK
 465 |     |                 || tickLower % key.tickSpacing != 0 || tickUpper % key.tickSpacing != 0
 466 |     |         ) revert InvalidRange();
 467 |     |         (quote.sqrtPriceX96,,,) = stateView.getSlot0(PoolId.wrap(poolId));
 468 |     |         uint160 lower = TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickLower);
 469 |     |         uint160 upper = TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickUpper);
 470 |     |         quote.liquidity = LiquidityAmounts.getLiquidityForAmounts(
 471 |     |             quote.sqrtPriceX96, lower, upper, amount0Max, amount1Max
 472 |     |         );
 473 |     |         if (quote.liquidity == 0 || quote.liquidity > uint128(type(int128).max)) {
 474 |     |             revert InvalidLiquidity();
 475 |     |         }
 476 |     |         (quote.amount0, quote.amount1) =
 477 |     |             _amounts(quote.sqrtPriceX96, lower, upper, quote.liquidity, true);
 478 |     |         if (quote.amount0 > amount0Max || quote.amount1 > amount1Max) revert InvalidLiquidity();
 479 |     |     }
 480 |     | 
 481 |     |     function getPoolKey(bytes32 poolId) public view returns (PoolKey memory key) {
 482 |     |         key = _pools[poolId];
 483 |     |         if (key.tickSpacing == 0) revert InvalidPool(poolId);
 484 |     |     }

 499 |     |     function getPoolIds(uint256 offset, uint256 limit)
 500 |     |         external
 501 |     |         view
 502 |     |         returns (bytes32[] memory ids)
 503 |     |     {
 504 |     |         uint256 end = _pageEnd(offset, limit, _poolIds.length);
 505 |     |         if (offset >= end) return new bytes32[](0);
 506 |     |         ids = new bytes32[](end - offset);
 507 |     |         for (uint256 i; i < ids.length; ++i) {
 508 |     |             ids[i] = _poolIds[offset + i];
 509 |     |         }
 510 |     |     }
 511 |     | 
 512 |     |     /// @notice Historical IDs opened by a user; consult getPosition for their closed status.
 513 |     |     function getDepositorPositionIds(address depositor, uint256 offset, uint256 limit)
 514 |     |         external
 515 |     |         view
 516 |     |         returns (uint256[] memory ids)
 517 |     |     {
 518 |     |         uint256[] storage all = _depositorPositionIds[depositor];
 519 |     |         uint256 end = _pageEnd(offset, limit, all.length);
 520 |     |         if (offset >= end) return new uint256[](0);
 521 |     |         ids = new uint256[](end - offset);
 522 |     |         for (uint256 i; i < ids.length; ++i) {
 523 |     |             ids[i] = all[offset + i];
 524 |     |         }
 525 |     |     }

 527 |     |     /// @notice User ownership, NFT custody, live balances, fee commission and collection history.
 528 |     |     /// @dev owner is the beneficiary; nftOwner is the ERC721 custodian. Principal excludes fees.
 529 |     |     function getPosition(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (PositionView memory) {
 530 |     |         if (_deposits[tokenId].depositor == address(0)) revert UnknownPosition(tokenId);
 531 |     |         return _positionView(tokenId, _ownerOf(tokenId));
 532 |     |     }
 533 |     | 
 534 |     |     /// @notice Active positions belonging to this beneficiary, excluding closed positions.
 535 |     |     /// @dev Cursor indexes this USER's historical IDs. Each call scans at most limit IDs; pages
 536 |     |     /// can be empty with more remaining. Continue until nextCursor == depositCount(user).
 537 |     |     function getUserPositions(address user, uint256 cursor, uint256 limit)
 538 |     |         external
 539 |     |         view
 540 |     |         returns (PositionView[] memory positions, uint256 nextCursor)
 541 |     |     {
 542 |     |         if (user == address(0)) revert InvalidOwner();
 543 |     |         uint256[] storage ids = _depositorPositionIds[user];
 544 |     |         nextCursor = _pageEnd(cursor, limit, ids.length);
 545 |     |         if (cursor >= nextCursor) return (new PositionView[](0), nextCursor);
 546 |     |         uint256[] memory matches = new uint256[](nextCursor - cursor);
 547 |     |         uint256 count;
 548 |     |         for (uint256 i = cursor; i < nextCursor; ++i) {
 549 |     |             uint256 id = ids[i];
 550 |     |             if (!_deposits[id].closed) matches[count++] = id;
 551 |     |         }
 552 |     |         positions = new PositionView[](count);
 553 |     |         for (uint256 i; i < count; ++i) {
 554 |     |             positions[i] = _positionView(matches[i], _ownerOf(matches[i]));
 555 |     |         }
 556 |     |     }
 557 |     | 
 558 |     |     function _positionView(uint256 tokenId, address nftOwner)
 559 |     |         private
 560 |     |         view
 561 |     |         returns (PositionView memory p)
 562 |     |     {
 563 |     |         DepositRecord storage record = _deposits[tokenId];
 564 |     |         p.tokenId = tokenId;
 565 |     |         p.poolId = record.poolId;
 566 |     |         p.depositor = record.depositor;
 567 |     |         p.owner = record.depositor;
 568 |     |         p.nftOwner = nftOwner;
 569 |     |         p.poolKey = _pools[record.poolId];
 570 |     |         p.tickLower = record.tickLower;
 571 |     |         p.tickUpper = record.tickUpper;
 572 |     |         p.initialLiquidity = record.initialLiquidity;
 573 |     |         p.amount0Deposited = record.amount0Deposited;
 574 |     |         p.amount1Deposited = record.amount1Deposited;
 575 |     |         p.openedAt = record.openedAt;
 576 |     |         p.closed = record.closed;
 577 |     |         p.feesCollected0 = record.feesCollected0;
 578 |     |         p.feesCollected1 = record.feesCollected1;
 579 |     |         p.commissionAccrued0 = record.commissionAccrued0;
 580 |     |         p.commissionAccrued1 = record.commissionAccrued1;
 581 |     |         p.exists = nftOwner != address(0);
 582 |     |         if (!p.exists || p.closed) return p;
 583 |     | 
 584 |     |         PoolId id = PoolId.wrap(p.poolId);
 585 |     |         uint256 last0;
 586 |     |         uint256 last1;
 587 |     |         (p.liquidity, last0, last1) = stateView.getPositionInfo(
 588 |     |             id, address(positionManager), p.tickLower, p.tickUpper, bytes32(tokenId)
 589 |     |         );
 590 |     |         int24 tick;
 591 |     |         (p.sqrtPriceX96, tick,,) = stateView.getSlot0(id);
 592 |     |         // An empty position may have uninitialized boundary ticks after removal.
 593 |     |         if (p.liquidity == 0) return p;
 594 |     |         p.inRange = tick >= p.tickLower && tick < p.tickUpper;
 595 |     |         (p.amount0, p.amount1) = _amounts(
 596 |     |             p.sqrtPriceX96,
 597 |     |             TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(p.tickLower),
 598 |     |             TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(p.tickUpper),
 599 |     |             p.liquidity,
 600 |     |             false
 601 |     |         );
 602 |     |         (uint256 growth0, uint256 growth1) =
 603 |     |             stateView.getFeeGrowthInside(id, p.tickLower, p.tickUpper);
 604 |     |         // Fee growth intentionally wraps modulo 2^256 in v4.
 605 |     |         unchecked {
 606 |     |             growth0 -= last0;
 607 |     |             growth1 -= last1;
 608 |     |         }
 609 |     |         p.fees0 = FullMath.mulDiv(growth0, p.liquidity, 1 << 128);
 610 |     |         p.fees1 = FullMath.mulDiv(growth1, p.liquidity, 1 << 128);
 611 |     |         (p.commission0,) = _commission(p.fees0, record.commissionRemainder0);
 612 |     |         (p.commission1,) = _commission(p.fees1, record.commissionRemainder1);
 613 |     |         p.netFees0 = p.fees0 - p.commission0;
 614 |     |         p.netFees1 = p.fees1 - p.commission1;
 615 |     |     }
 616 |     | 
 617 |     |     function _ownedPosition(uint256 tokenId) private view returns (DepositRecord storage record) {
 618 |     |         record = _deposits[tokenId];
 619 |     |         if (record.depositor == address(0)) revert UnknownPosition(tokenId);
 620 |     |         if (record.depositor != msg.sender) revert NotPositionOwner();
 621 |     |         if (record.closed) revert PositionClosed();
 622 |     |         if (_ownerOf(tokenId) != address(this)) revert UnexpectedPosition();
 623 |     |     }
 624 |     | 
 625 |     |     /// @dev Compute commission on newly realized fees with a per-position, per-currency carry.
 626 |     |     /// Repeated small claims charge floor(total realized fees / 10), not floor(each claim / 10).
 627 |     |     function _commission(uint256 fees, uint16 previousRemainder)
 628 |     |         private
 629 |     |         pure
 630 |     |         returns (uint256 commission, uint16 remainder)
 631 |     |     {
 632 |     |         uint256 fractional = mulmod(fees, COMMISSION_BPS, BPS_DENOMINATOR) + previousRemainder;
 633 |     |         commission =
 634 |     |             FullMath.mulDiv(fees, COMMISSION_BPS, BPS_DENOMINATOR) + fractional / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
 635 |     |         remainder = (fractional % BPS_DENOMINATOR).toUint16();
 636 |     |     }
 637 |     | 
 638 |     |     /// @dev Actual receipts minus exact exit principal are the newly realized LP fees.
 639 |     |     /// Update accounting before transfers, and leave preexisting token balances untouched.
 640 |     |     function _distribute(
 641 |     |         DepositRecord storage record,
 642 |     |         Payout memory payout,
 643 |     |         IERC20 token0,
 644 |     |         IERC20 token1,
 645 |     |         uint256 before0,
 646 |     |         uint256 before1
 647 |     |     ) private {
 648 |     |         uint256 balance0 = token0.balanceOf(address(this));
 649 |     |         uint256 balance1 = token1.balanceOf(address(this));
 650 |     |         if (balance0 < before0 || balance1 < before1) revert InsufficientProceeds();
 651 |     |         uint256 received0 = balance0 - before0;
 652 |     |         uint256 received1 = balance1 - before1;
 653 |     |         if (received0 < payout.principal0 || received1 < payout.principal1) {
 654 |     |             revert InsufficientProceeds();
 655 |     |         }
 656 |     |         payout.fees0 = received0 - payout.principal0;
 657 |     |         payout.fees1 = received1 - payout.principal1;
 658 |     |         (payout.commission0, record.commissionRemainder0) =
 659 |     |             _commission(payout.fees0, record.commissionRemainder0);
 660 |     |         (payout.commission1, record.commissionRemainder1) =
 661 |     |             _commission(payout.fees1, record.commissionRemainder1);
 662 |     |         payout.amount0 = received0 - payout.commission0;
 663 |     |         payout.amount1 = received1 - payout.commission1;
 664 |     |         record.feesCollected0 += payout.fees0;
 665 |     |         record.feesCollected1 += payout.fees1;
 666 |     |         record.commissionAccrued0 += payout.commission0;
 667 |     |         record.commissionAccrued1 += payout.commission1;
 668 |     | 
 669 |     |         address recipient = feeRecipient;
 670 |     |         _accrueCommission(recipient, address(token0), payout.commission0);
 671 |     |         _accrueCommission(recipient, address(token1), payout.commission1);
 672 |     |         if (payout.amount0 != 0) token0.safeTransfer(record.depositor, payout.amount0);
 673 |     |         if (payout.amount1 != 0) token1.safeTransfer(record.depositor, payout.amount1);
 674 |     |         if (token0.balanceOf(address(this)) != before0 + payout.commission0) {
 675 |     |             revert UnsupportedToken(address(token0));
 676 |     |         }
 677 |     |         if (token1.balanceOf(address(this)) != before1 + payout.commission1) {
 678 |     |             revert UnsupportedToken(address(token1));
 679 |     |         }
 680 |     |     }
 681 |     | 
 682 |     |     function _accrueCommission(address recipient, address token, uint256 amount) private {
 683 |     |         if (amount == 0) return;
 684 |     |         claimableCommission[recipient][token] += amount;
 685 |     |         totalClaimableCommission[token] += amount;
 686 |     |         emit CommissionAccrued(recipient, token, amount);
 687 |     |     }
 688 |     | 
 689 |     |     function _ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) private view returns (address) {
 690 |     |         try IERC721(address(positionManager)).ownerOf(tokenId) returns (address owner) {
 691 |     |             return owner;
 692 |     |         } catch {
 693 |     |             return address(0);
 694 |     |         }
 695 |     |     }
 696 |     | 
 697 |     |     function _pageEnd(uint256 offset, uint256 limit, uint256 length)
 698 |     |         private
 699 |     |         pure
 700 |     |         returns (uint256)
 701 |     |     {
 702 |     |         if (limit == 0 || limit > MAX_PAGE_SIZE) revert InvalidPageSize();
 703 |     |         if (offset >= length) return length;
 704 |     |         return offset + (limit < length - offset ? limit : length - offset);
 705 |     |     }
 706 |     | 
 707 |     |     function _pull(IERC20 token, uint128 budget) private returns (uint256 beforeBalance) {
 708 |     |         beforeBalance = token.balanceOf(address(this));
 709 |     |         if (budget != 0) token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), budget);
 710 |     |         if (token.balanceOf(address(this)) != beforeBalance + budget) {
 711 |     |             revert UnsupportedToken(address(token));
 712 |     |         }
 713 |     |     }
 714 |     | 
 715 |     |     function _approve(IERC20 token, uint128 amount) private {
 716 |     |         token.forceApprove(address(permit2), amount);
 717 |     |         // Permit2 treats a zero expiration as block.timestamp. No authority is
 718 |     |         // retained after this transaction; zero amounts revoke the remainder.
 719 |     |         permit2.approve(address(token), address(positionManager), amount, 0);
 720 |     |     }
 721 |     | 
 722 |     |     function _refund(IERC20 token, uint256 beforeBalance, uint128 budget)
 723 |     |         private
 724 |     |         returns (uint256 spent)
 725 |     |     {
 726 |     |         uint256 remaining = token.balanceOf(address(this));
 727 |     |         if (remaining < beforeBalance || remaining - beforeBalance > budget) {
 728 |     |             revert UnsupportedToken(address(token));
 729 |     |         }
 730 |     |         uint256 refund = remaining - beforeBalance;
 731 |     |         spent = budget - refund;
 732 |     |         if (refund != 0) token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, refund);
 733 |     |         if (token.balanceOf(address(this)) != beforeBalance) {
 734 |     |             revert UnsupportedToken(address(token));
 735 |     |         }
 736 |     |     }
 737 |     | 
 738 |     |     function _amounts(uint160 price, uint160 lower, uint160 upper, uint128 liquidity, bool roundUp)
 739 |     |         private
 740 |     |         pure
 741 |     |         returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)
 742 |     |     {
 743 |     |         if (price <= lower) {
 744 |     |             return (SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(lower, upper, liquidity, roundUp), 0);
 745 |     |         }
 746 |     |         if (price >= upper) {
 747 |     |             return (0, SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(lower, upper, liquidity, roundUp));
 748 |     |         }
 749 |     |         return (
 750 |     |             SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(price, upper, liquidity, roundUp),
 751 |     |             SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(lower, price, liquidity, roundUp)
 752 |     |         );
 753 |     |     }

 795 |     |     /// @dev Actual receipts minus exact exit principal are the newly realized LP fees. The

 814 | *   |         (payout.principal1, payout.fees1) = _split(received1, payout.principal1);
 815 | *   |         (payout.commission0, record.commissionRemainder0) =

 835 |     |     /// @dev Split what the pool delivered into principal and newly realized fees. A token that
 836 |     |     /// rounds against the receiver can deliver a few units less than the exact principal;
 837 |     |     /// that is paid out as it arrived instead of blocking the exit. A larger shortfall reverts.
 838 | *   |     function _split(uint256 received, uint256 expectedPrincipal)
 839 |     |         private
 840 |     |         pure

 842 |     |     {

 844 | *   |             return (expectedPrincipal, received - expectedPrincipal);
 845 |     |         }
 846 |     |         if (expectedPrincipal - received > MAX_PAYOUT_DUST) revert InsufficientProceeds();
 847 |     |         return (received, 0);
 848 |     |     }

 860 |     |     /// @dev After paying out, the router must hold what it is meant to keep. Less means the
